discrepancies.claim: library.toFunction(pointer, signature) is documented with no YAML added: block, as if it were part of the v26.1.0 class.
discrepancies.behavior: lib.toFunction is undefined in v26.13.0. It exists on v28.0.0-pre (main).

discrepancies.claim: FFI APIs are restricted without --allow-ffi; FFI permission is required when creating a toFunction wrapper even after it is revoked.
discrepancies.behavior: After process.permission.drop('ffi'), an already-open library still allows getFunction(), registerCallback() and calls. Only new libraries, toFunction and the memory helpers throw ERR_ACCESS_DENIED. The docs do not say what drop does to getFunction or registerCallback. Seen on v26.13.0 and main.
